rundown: Knicks beat Raptors 111-102 at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, ON in front of 19,800. Knicks led 54-50 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Knicks won it 31-19. Their win chance dropped as low as 25% along the way.
Leading the way — Knicks: Jalen Brunson 31 pts; Karl-Anthony Towns 8 ast, 16 reb. Raptors: Ja'Kobe Walter 25 pts; Immanuel Quickley 7 ast; Jakob Poeltl 6 reb.
Where Knicks won it: they shot 53% to 50% and won the boards 44-23.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Knicks closed as 2.5-point favorites and covered by 6.5; the total closed at 215.5 and they combined for 213, under by 2.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 17, 7:28 PM ET. It had Knicks 70% and Raptors 30%, projecting Knicks 110.4 – Raptors 104.3 (214.7 total, Knicks by 6.1).

Final: Knicks 111 – Raptors 102. Right winner: it had Knicks at 70%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Knicks came in with a league-average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (7-6, 109.9 scored and 104 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 80 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 110.4, they scored 111 (+0.6 points, 1% over); projected to allow 104.3, they allowed 102 (−2.3 points, 2% under).

Raptors came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (5-8, 113.8 scored and 112.8 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 79 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 104.3, they scored 102 (−2.3 points, 2% under); projected to allow 110.4, they allowed 111 (+0.6 points, 1% over).

The bigger miss was Raptors' scoring (-2.3 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 213 against 214.7 projected (-1.7), about the 46th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Knicks by 9 against Knicks by 6.1 projected, about the 40th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
TOR ML (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 42% vs 44% fair (-1.4 pts) — ungraded; lost to the close (closing fair chance 45%). NY ML (-142) at -142: the algo gave it 58% vs 56% fair (+1.4 pts) — ungraded; lost to the close (closing fair chance 55%). TOR +2.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.2 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. NY -2.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.2 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. OVER 215.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.2 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close. UNDER 215.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.2 pts) — ungraded; same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 67% of bets on Knicks, 64% of the money — Knicks covered; total: 89% of bets on the over, 85% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 86% of bets on Knicks, 82% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Raptors, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.989 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.2 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 98 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.997 and gives home teams +0.7 points. Team corrections so far: Knicks attack ×0.994, defense ×0.981 (6 games); Raptors attack ×0.982, defense ×1.000 (6 games).

The tracker grades it from the final within a few minutes; then it joins the learning.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
